2610.09360.title: TopoGraphRAG-Bench: Evaluating Multimodal GraphRAG on Layout-Grounded Evidence Reasoning
2610.09360.paper_summary: Real-world documents distribute evidence across text, tables, figures, and captions within complex page layouts. Answering complex questions over such documents therefore requires more than retrieving relevant passages: systems must recover the evidence topology that connects heterogeneous evidence units. Existing GraphRAG evaluations remain largely text-centered, while multimodal document RAG benchmarks assess cross-modal retrieval and generation without directly evaluating recovery of the intended evidence topology. We introduce TOPOGRAPHRAG-BENCH, a layout-grounded benchmark for multimodal evidence reasoning in GraphRAG, comprising 2,024 questions over 201 long, visually rich documents. Questions are constructed bottom-up from text, figure, and table evidence units under three controlled topologies: single-hop retrieval, bridge-chain reasoning, and multi-source synthesis. To ensure that questions preserve their intended structure, we apply counterfactual validation for shortcut resistance, modality necessity, and evidence necessity. We evaluate text-only GraphRAG, page-level visual retrieval, and multimodal GraphRAG systems using retrieval, generation, and topology-aware reasoning metrics. Multimodal GraphRAG systems achieve the strongest overall performance, but still fail when visual-textual evidence alignment or multi-unit composition is incomplete. Text-only GraphRAG struggles when key dependencies are grounded in figures or tables, while page-level visual retrieval lacks the fine-grained structure needed for topology recovery. These findings motivate GraphRAG systems that move beyond text-derived entity relation graphs to explicitly model document layouts, cross-modal evidence alignment, and the reasoning roles of evidence units. Code and data are available at https://richardlrc.github.io/TopoGraphRAG-Bench/.
2610.09360.paper_summary_zh: 真實世界的文件在複雜的頁面佈局中將證據分散於文本、表格、圖形和標題之間。因而，回答這些文件中的複雜問題需要的不僅僅是檢索相關段落：系統必須恢復連接異質證據單元的證據拓撲。現有的GraphRAG評估仍然主要集中於文本，而多模態文件RAG基準則評估跨模態檢索和生成，但未直接評估預期證據拓撲的恢復。我們介紹了TOPOGRAPHRAG-BENCH，這是一個基於佈局的多模態證據推理基準，包含201份長篇、視覺豐富的文件中的2,024個問題。問題是從文本、圖形和表格證據單元自下而上構建的，涵蓋三種受控拓撲：單跳檢索、橋接鏈推理和多源綜合。為了確保問題保留其預期結構，我們應用反事實驗證以抵抗捷徑、模態必要性和證據必要性。我們使用檢索、生成和拓撲感知推理指標評估僅文本的GraphRAG、頁面級視覺檢索和多模態GraphRAG系統。多模態GraphRAG系統在整體性能上表現最強，但在視覺-文本證據對齊或多單元組合不完整時仍然失敗。僅文本的GraphRAG在關鍵依賴關係基於圖形或表格時表現不佳，而頁面級視覺檢索缺乏拓撲恢復所需的細粒度結構。這些發現促使GraphRAG系統超越基於文本的實體關係圖，明確建模文件佈局、跨模態證據對齊以及證據單元的推理角色。代碼和數據可在 https://richardlrc.github.io/TopoGraphRAG-Bench/ 獲得。
